business_disposition.why_the_intent_is_material: The reviewed Evidence explicitly says AI server unit volume, ASP and the price-volume-mix bridge are missing, so the proposed follow-up is relevant to value capture.

confirmed_findings: The product_intents Tool Schema described the field as concise but omitted the local maximum length and array cardinality enforced by the validator.
The model produced one 222-character product intent while the hidden local ceiling was 120 characters.

Even if that text were shortened, the submitted pricing_and_mix facet would still reject shipments, capacity, orders and backlog because the route contract allows only revenue, profit, margin and ASP metrics for that query family.

The Tool Schema exposed one global facet enum and one global metric enum but did not encode their dependent validity, so the provider could generate an apparently schema-valid combination that the local compiler would reject.
A proposal-only formatting failure terminated the whole loop instead of returning a typed repairable tool observation within the existing bounded budget.

required_structural_fix.single_compiled_contract_source: Compile Tool Schema, local validator, fake path and repair feedback from the same provider-neutral EvidenceRequest contract and route policy.
required_structural_fix.dependent_intent_shape: Represent each EvidenceRequest as bounded intent atoms whose facet and metric set is locally compatible; split a legitimate cross-family research need into multiple deterministic request atoms instead of expecting the model to guess one family.
required_structural_fix.visible_constraints: Expose exact maxItems, maxLength and forbidden-surface constraints in the tool schema wherever the standard API supports them.
required_structural_fix.repairable_proposal_boundary: Return a typed rejected_not_executed proposal result with safe allowed-family hints for local format/facet mismatch, while keeping the gap open and consuming the original call budget; do not repair Judgment, identity, Evidence, NumericFact or citations.
required_structural_fix.zero_call_scope: Replay the immutable R2 tool call and prove deterministic split or typed repair, all four tool schemas against validators, DELL/MU/NVDA fake paths, and mutation for cross-case, cross-cell, invalid facet-metric and length boundaries before any future provider call.

known_boundary: R2 proves standard tool-result continuation through two accepted same-cell read receipts and a business-relevant natural EvidenceRequest attempt. It does not qualify the proposal contract, final Judgment, five-cell loop, eight-dimension report, qualified-human acceptance, Workbench or S3 acceptance.
